title: Session Host port, version 1
description: The one port that places an agent session: start, alive, front, retire. Adapters: terminal (Terminal Control), direct (screenless prepared command). Spec: docs/platform/session-host/spec.md.

key.description: Same key shape as terminal-control; for a run the attempt id, for a head session <persona>-<name>.

display.description: Terminal Control display fields; written to the screen only, never read back.

text.description: The full opening text, never a pointer to a file.

delivery.description: typed: through the shared delivery step into the composer, visibly (terminal only). argument or file: a screenless host passes it itself.

groupKey.description: Panes of one group share a tab (terminal only).

beside.description: Open next to this existing placement (terminal only).

command.description: The prepared command. For direct it is already contained: the adapter never builds containment.

role.description: head on host direct is refused.

rules: terminal: Terminal Control allocate, then launch (quoted line), then, only when opening is given, await_ready and deliver_brief through fgos-agent-protocol over the port's own PaneIo.
direct: starts the prepared command without a screen; opening.delivery must be argument or file, typed is refused with opening-delivery-unsupported.
role head with host direct answers unsupported / head-needs-interactive-host.
a key that already has a live placement answers that placement; it never starts a second one.
unknown is never turned into gone.
answers whether the placement exists; who the session is and whether it is the live holder of a role stays Identity's.
terminal: the focus operation of Terminal Control.
direct and any screenless host: unsupported.
terminal: Terminal Control release; only a pane the port started is closed, never a tab.
retiring a placement already gone answers retired.
